info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Special Pricing Conditions Management API
info.description: The Special Pricing Conditions Management API allows businesses to set and manage unique pricing structures for products in their banking system. This API provides operations to create and configure special pricing conditions tailored to specific circumstances, such as customer profiles or seasonal promotions. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and pricing analysts who need to implement strategic pricing initiatives. By streamlining the management of these pricing conditions, organizations can enhance competitiveness and improve customer satisfaction.

post.summary: Create a new special pricing condition.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new special pricing condition for a product. You can specify various parameters that define the pricing rules and conditions applicable to specific products or customer segments. Ensure that all required parameters are provided in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update special pricing conditions for products. It must contain the relevant details about the pricing conditions as specified in the schema.
